The verified state and the result (funds hold, authority unknown) arrive in sentences four and five. Borderline: all inside the opening Finding paragraph.
"The buying entity's signing resolution naming the signatory — the buyer delivers it; your counsel can request and read it."

Funds under Verified, authority "UNKNOWN", price stated only and listed open. Weakness: count says "2 not verified ... 10 unknown" but the twelve open items carry no individual state, so the two cannot be identified.

Ends with a work record: "Evidence checked: none beyond your message ... Calculations run: letter amount minus stated price". "Validator: VALID" and the ledger hash cannot be confirmed from the response.
$6.5M, $5.9M and $600,000 each appear once, in the Verified entry; the Finding gives no numbers.
Each of twelve open items names the document or statement and what it lets the parties see, e.g. "Time to fund: ... Lets the parties compare it with the closing term."

notes: Clean on neutrality and funds arithmetic. Twelve open items go well beyond what the request raised, and the count's not-verified/unknown split cannot be mapped to items; the result sits just past the third sentence.
